title: Water Quality and Hydroclimatic Dataset for Rivers and Streams of Dhaka, Bangladesh
authors: Parishmita Sinha; Nirab Debnath; Prithwiraj Bhattacharjee
size: 1,495 records; 58 coordinate pairs; 60 river/location name combinations; 104 dates
used: GIS; pH/DO/COD screening; DO model training and temporal evaluation
transform: Normalize Tongi Khal casing; flag six invalid negative-value rows; retain raw file; do not use supplied WQI or Pollution_Label; keep unspecified nutrient chemical forms out of objective comparisons.
limits: Repository-published measurements, not independently verified lab results. Original QA/custody documentation is incomplete. Historical, geographically limited and temporally clustered.

title: Dataset for the BASIS Framework: High-Resolution Spatial, Diurnal, and Hydraulic Fecal Pollution Tracking in Resource-Limited Urban Channels
authors: Bijit Kumar Banik; Rahul Das Gupta; Md. Hasibul Chowdhury; Imran Hasan; Md. Imran Kabir; Muhammad Azizul Hoque
size: Seven worksheets; extracted 40 velocity points, six hydraulic groups and 62 unlocated quality samples
period: February 2025 quality campaign; May 16, 2025 velocity survey; hydraulic-group timestamps absent
used: Separate survey GIS layer; mixing/closure investigation examples; explicit unlocated-sample audit
transform: Read published mean concentrations; multiply FC means by 10^5 to CFU/100 mL; do not count replicates as independent sites; do not join survey numeric IDs to quality-station IDs.
limits: No industrial-emitter labels. The actual quality worksheet lacks the coordinates suggested in broad metadata. No invented geolocation or complete urban-drain topology.

title: NASA POWER monthly PRECTOTCORR at 22.57 N, 89.51 E
license: NASA data attribution; source terms apply
transform: Convert mm/day monthly means to mm/month using calendar day counts; thresholds computed only from training.
limits: Gridded model-derived data, not a local rain gauge; historical revisions and current endpoints can change. Not a live tank-stock feed.

title: NOAA CPC Relative Oceanic Nino Index historical table
period: Historical table used for lagged 1984–2025 experiment
used: Candidate climate feature and baseline comparison
transform: Index values by center month; target-month minus three lag, with season ending before target.
limits: Modern historical revisions; not as-issued hindcasts. RONI addition did not improve Brier loss. No local storm/salinity attribution.

title: Bangladesh Environment Conservation Rules 2023
authors: Government of Bangladesh / Bangladesh Government Press
license: Official regulatory reference; no endorsement implied
size: 107-page Gazette PDF; relevant table on PDF p.53 / printed p.3061
used: pH 6–9, DO >=5 mg/L and COD <=50 mg/L screening objectives
transform: Visual transcription from the rendered table; no reliance on garbled extracted Bengali text.
limits: Only three matched parameters used. Intended use is inland fisheries. This is not finished drinking-water assessment, effluent compliance or a legal finding about pre-2023 samples.

title: Climate++ fictional water-continuity network on Dacope roads (GeoPackage)
license: Synthetic layers: project terms to be set by the team. Embedded road geometry is OpenStreetMap, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (HOT export). Dacope boundary from the HDX Bangladesh administrative boundaries; confirm its licence on the HDX dataset page.
size: 13 layers; 6 network nodes, 2 catchments, 3 hazard polygons, 18 access rows
used: Situation map layers; derived blocked delivery days; exposure flags
transform: Nodes and polygons digitised in QGIS on OSM roads (snapped); shortest paths on the road network, with storm polygons removed from the roads by geometric difference; scripts/build-gis-network.py converts the layers to JSON and applies the stated speed and thresholds.
limits: Fictional network and hazard polygons; not a forecast and not an operating system. Speed is one assumed value for all roads; thresholds are scenario assumptions. OSM completeness is unverified; nothing is validated on the ground.
